level2.title: God So Loved the World
level2.story: Jesus spoke with Nicodemus, a leader who came to Him at night. Jesus said, "God so loved the world that He gave His only Son." Everyone who believes in Him will not perish but will have eternal life. God did not send His Son to condemn the world, but to save it. Today we praise one God in three Persons: the Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit.
